lead: # The skills library itself. The resolution reads the store directly rather than taking a library on
# the wire — see the `skill` module header.
# The packaged/overlay `mcp/builtin-servers.json`, so the built-ins come from the SAME file the app
# and the frontend see rather than a second hardcoded copy free to drift.
# `bsc-resolve` — what a session RECEIVES: its skills and its MCP servers.
# Lean by construction. `skilldb` is SQLite (via bsc-sqlite-util) and `bsc-config` is a file overlay,
# so nothing here reaches DuckDB and a scoped `cargo check -p bsc-resolve` stays seconds rather than
# minutes. It depends on NO Tauri and on no app crate — that independence is the whole point of the
# move, not a side effect of it.
sections.name: [dependencies]

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
